summary: New Found Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a credit agreement for a Cdn$105,000,000 loan facility from EdgePoint Investment Group Inc., with subsidiaries Maritime Resources Corp. and 2823988 Ontario Corp. as guarantors. The filing also includes a material change report and warrants. This is a routine financing arrangement — not a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or any other listed special situation. The registrant is merely entering a credit facility and issuing warrants; no acquisition, divestiture, or change of control is involved. Accordingly, this is not a special situation filing.
